---
title: "wrapped fixture: a document-level fig-column margin"
filters:
  - wrapped
fig-column: margin
format:
  html: default
  pdf:
    keep-tex: true
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
    fig-format: png
  docx: default
---

With `fig-column: margin` in the document, Quarto puts each figure float in
the margin in HTML, PDF through LaTeX, and PDF through Typst, a cell's
float with its own `fig-column: body` included. Word has no margin. A
wrapped float keeps its normal layout with a warning in every format. A
captioned image with no id is not a float, so it stays in the body and wraps.
